Boundaries for Yukon regional land use planning. Boundaries are subject to revision as Government and Yukon First Nations agree to commence regional planning. Once appointed and operating, regional land use planning commissions are to develop and recommend a regional land use plan for their region. Yukon Government and affected First Nations will then approve and implement the plan. For more information, please refer to [https://planyukon.ca/index.php/resources/planning-regions](https://imsva91-ctp.trendmicro.com:443/wis/clicktime/v1/query?url=http%3a%2f%2fplanyukon.ca%2findex.php%2fresources%2fplanning%2dregions&umid=6F25C300-8990-EC05-B9CB-56B31836836C&auth=c132af8ee7c9d1278d61a701569070a095ce962e-59acfdec1b910392e8b8e2e1daecb2cc00dab07f)
